title: cupressus sempervirens subsp. horizontalis
intro: Cupressus sempervirens subsp. horizontalis, commonly known as Italian stone pine or Italian cypress, is a coniferous evergreen tree native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality due to its sedative and anti-anxiety properties. The therapeutic actions of Cupressus sempervirens subsp. horizontalis include acting as an antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory, which can help alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis, and skin conditions, like acne. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenes, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
